description: Get full details for one spot on Nanukamachi-dori by slug or name. Returns the full description by default; use offset and maxChars to page through long articles. descriptionTruncated and nextOffset indicate whether more text remains.

maxChars.description: Maximum characters to return. Omit to return the full description.

name.description: Spot name, e.g. とんかつ大将.

offset.description: Start offset for the description. Use nextOffset to continue.

name: get-spot
title: Get a shop or sight
